You can also investigate security alerts provided by Defender for Cloud that make use of the
cloud process events data in advanced hunting to understand details in the process tree for
processes that include a security alert.
To hunt for process events including a given term (represented by "x" in the query below) in
the command-line arguments:
Kusto
To investigate unusual process events invoked as part of a pod in a Kubernetes cluster:
Kusto
